style: Photorealistic commercial photo. The necklace is exactly the one in the reference image: a silver-tone barbed-wire chain made of thin twisted wire links with small wrapped barbs, each barb with short spikes, spaced evenly all the way round, and a small lobster clasp. No pendant, no tag, no charm, no logo, no text, no watermark anywhere in the image. Keep its real size: about 4 mm thick, a 45 cm necklace that sits on the collarbone. Natural skin texture, realistic hands and anatomy, November season styling.
